Write a detailed, continuous technical explanation of how a local
language model performs inference on a GPU with limited video memory. Explain
the model loading process, memory allocation, attention, transformer layers,
tokenization, prompt processing, autoregressive decoding, cache management,
CPU and GPU coordination, synchronization, numerical precision, and memory
pressure. Develop every topic carefully, with concrete examples and connected
paragraphs. Continue the explanation in depth until the output token limit is
reached. Do not provide a short summary or stop voluntarily.
